scenario.NAME: The Salty Dungeon
scenario.DESC: Bethrezen sent forth packs of demonic beasts to retrieve this Dwarven key, for the deliverance of Asteroth would prove to be of vital importance. Such an ally could only bring glory to the Legion's name.
scenario.BRIEFLONG1:
Centuries ago, the Clans imprisoned a demon lord named Asteroth.  They lured the mighty fiend into a hollow mountain, blocked the entrance, and then filled it with seawater, leaving the devil imprisoned in his salty dungeon.  
 

Asteroth toiled.  Fo_

Tscen.TEXT: При этом ужасном имени дрожит каждый ребёнок. Этот лорд ада известен кровожадностью. Говорят, однажды он съел 1000 рабов на пиру, устроенном Бетрезеном в честь победы над царством света.
Верховный лорд гномов известен неистовством в бою и храбростью перед лицом превосходящих сил. Однажды он семь дней и ночей сражался с могучим красным драконом АРФУРУЗОНОМ и всё-таки победил его.

Counselor 
"Their defenses were weak... These lands have likely endured much suffering!"

Sorcerer 
"I feel the presence of Asteroth, he must be on these lands somewhere..."

Rock Giant 
"Without the Runic Key, all of your efforts will be in vain! Ha ha ha!"

Veteran 
"By Wotans beard! Your presence here will not go unpunished by the Clans..."

Orc Champion 
"You attack us - fire-skin!? Ghou will be kill by us!"

Dwarf 
"We have no dealings with the Cloudkeeper Clan... The High King Morok fell into madness after the death of his son!"

Hill Giant 
"You cannot be! The Ragnarok foreseen by the Loremasters!? We will vanquish you!"

Counselor 
"All are dead in this town, Master..."

Demonologist 
"We found the gate master! We must use the Runic Key to open it..."

Counselor 
"We have found the opening master!!! Asteroth must not be far from this place..."

Asteroth
"Demons here?! How did you gain entrance to this area?"

Demonologist 
"Bethrezen sent us to liberate you... The denizens of Hell are drawing together once more!"

Demonologist 
"Well... He is free but something happened..."

Sorcerer 
"Asteroth is near... There is an atmosphere of evil which surrounds this place."
Sorcerer "This seems to be the source - Asteroth's presence can be felt strongly... Maybe this is the entrance? We must bring the Runic Key to this location..."

Arch-Devil 
"I feel uneasy about these ancient ruins... What lies within? I fear it is has mighty guardians..."

Rock Giant
"These lands are forbidden to your kind, begone beasts!"

Bethrezen
"We claim these lands as our own, half-man... I will scorch your lands and destroy all of you!"

Rock Giant
"You are welcome to try, boy... I will crush the arrogance out of you with my own two hands!"

Spearman 
"Leave these lands, vile creatures! If you persist, you will not live to see another day... Company - Charge!!!"

Demonologist 
"Master, the lands have evidently suffered much here... Asteroth's influence can be felt on these lands!"

Necromacer 
"Give us Uther... Mortis orders it! The demon child must be ours."

Counselor 
"The dead are rising from the ground... A trap!"

Sorcerer 
"Master! The key is here, wrapped in this ancient vestment. We have found the Runic Key! We are now ready to free Asteroth's from his prison. Let us depart!"

Duke 
"Fall back! Undead hordes are approaching through this passage!!! Prepare the cohorts for battle!"

Sorcerer 
"It seems that all of the inhabitants of the region are dead, Master... The Undead are still after our master Bethrezen!"

Counselor 
"There have been many Undead sightings in the region! The accursed Mortis has profited from all the destruction that has been wrought here."

Counselor 
"Master! The only way to reach Asteroth lies through Mountain Clans territory! They have a dangerous ally in the mythical Green Dragon... We must be prepared to face this beast..."

Counselor 
"Master, word has spread of a new cult spreading through the realm... They call themselves Occultists, and are protected by creatures which they summon through incantation. Who is leading this sect?"

Occultist 
"You have strayed too near the enemy, beasts! Mortis will crush you, and take from you what she wishes!"
